name: ladder-network
title: The whiteboard ladder on her subnet notes: spot it, see hers drawn, see the correct one
description: The ladder on a network topic: her notes put the 30-host Sales zone in 10.0.0.0/24 when she wants the smallest subnet that fits. A check gets only 'there's an error, can you spot it?'; 'no' redraws her zone on the board (the Illustrator) with a note on the wrong part, ending in a question; still stuck draws the correct subnet. Board only: no paper marks.

turns.student: Can you check my subnet for the Sales zone? I need the smallest subnet that fits 30 hosts.
